waste.what: Worked out which cells in the 1x5x1 box are free air around the locked flight (step tops, stringers, headroom) by dumping the built nbt cell by cell with a throwaway script.

waste.tool: `mcd blocks --check` against palette.json (or a palette-aware layers() that rejects off-palette ids at write time) run before drafting furniture

waste.what: Room walk and FIT depend on the parlor doorway and upper floor from other parts, so the room check cannot say OK in an isolated copy; I checked light and the render only.
waste.cost: two check runs that report UNREACHABLE and a hallway-to-nowhere issue I cannot clear here
waste.tool: `mcd room --assume-openings` or a stub-aware check that reports which failures come from unbuilt neighbours

Check the hanging lantern under the stringer and the upper-floor cell over the landing once the upper floor is built, since the hanging lantern at (86,5,14) was dropped because it floated without the upper floor.

left: The room check's walk verdict (UNREACHABLE, 0 of 3 floor cells) and the 'hallway to nowhere' FIT issue need the parlor doorway at x87 and the upper floor, which come from other parts; they are not verifiable in this copy and must be re-checked after the merge.
The coat rack and stringer lantern sit at the dead-end north pocket of the flight, so they should not block the route, but the walk check after merge must confirm it.
